{{Quote|I think I've earned the right to wear this again.|Ahsoka Tano to Cad Bane|<ref name="Children of the Force">{{TCW|Children of the Force}}</ref>}}
[[File:Anakin-OP.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] with his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] braid.]]

A '''Padawan braid''' was a type of braid worn by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]].

==Description==
Those who were of a [[Species/Legends|species]] that grew [[Hair/Legends|hair]] or grew a small single, long, and tight braid of hair behind their left or right [[Ear/Legends|ear]], though behind the right ear was traditional. Those who chose to could weave a ribbon of cloth or special beads like [[Silka bead/Legends|silka beads]] into the braid. Some species were recorded to have woven their facial hair into a braid (if they could not grow one from their scalp).

Members of species unable to grow hair might instead wear a woven braid of canvas or cloth around the wrist, neck, ear, or horn, or use body modifications such as [[Piercing/Legends|piercings]] or markings. Other alternatives emerged over the [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]: [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagarians]] and [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] wore [[circlet]]s on their cranial horns. [[Sluissi]] Jedi wore a simple [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] across their left cheek. [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] could have a medallion implanted below their foreheads. [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] could wear chains or beads that run between their [[Montral/Legends|montrals]]. [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] could wear chains or beads that run between their [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]].

==History==
Padawans that were members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] were encouraged to grow a braid or in some way show their rank for easy identification. When a Padawan was declared a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]], upon completion of the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials]] (around twenty standard years of age, though often earlier or later depending on the student) the lock would be severed with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] like it happened to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] during the Clone Wars. If a Padawan was instead expelled from the Order they had their braid removed, as happened to [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]].

In the [[New Jedi Order]], the practice of apprentices wearing braids was all but forgotten, though [[Ben Skywalker]] revived the old tradition for himself when he was unofficially apprenticed to [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]].

==Behind the scenes==
Between scenes of the [[prequel trilogy]] movies, Padawan braids worn by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] often change sides. All of these are mistakes in the movies (this could be due to the shot being flipped in post-production, or they wore hair extensions put on for the scene, as real braids take months or years to grow). Traditionally the braid is worn on the right.
